465-3899-6132.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 3.

618-3817-6798.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller with haste.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life
Repeat.

1308-2557-4826-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-7315-7737.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to High Score
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3388-7193.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3388-7193.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Omni-Changeling and Moritte of the Frost each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Omni-Changeling trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3388-7193.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

489-1594-1621-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-3110-3277.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3110-3277.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3110-3277.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1987-4477-6573.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-4477-6573.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone two or more times this game.
1987-4477-6573.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4477-6573.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

4866-4893-7426-7737.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
4866-4893-7426-7737.description:
Activate Sage of Fables by paying {1} due to Training Grounds and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3240-5631-5686-6462.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2556-3378-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
2556-3378-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and Peregrine Drake and causing you to draw a card.
When Mnemonic Wall and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
2556-3378-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

4657-4974-5295-6871.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three mana-producing lands.
4657-4974-5295-6871.description:
Activate three lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers three times, adding {3}
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {4} and tapping it, untapping the three mana-producing lands and Thousand-Year Elixir, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thousand-Year Elixir by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.
4657-4974-5295-6871.notes: You can tap more lands for mana each loop if desired. You'll need to pay an additional {1} in step 3 for each extra land tapped this way to untap them.

4559-4779-5805-7306.easyPrerequisites: Two or more opponents have lost life this turn.
4559-4779-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-4779-5805-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gev.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1169-1563-3899-4365.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7157.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Arcbound Lancer.
When Arcbound Lancer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Lancer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Lancer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2893-3875-4500-6763.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Retreat to Kazandu trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

372-961-6991.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Against All Odds exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-961-6991.description:
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Donnie & April and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Donnie & April trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Against All Odds.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Donnie & April and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

3542-3647-4823.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
3542-3647-4823.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Timeless Witness and Palinchron
When Timeless Witness and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
3542-3647-4823.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Palinchron.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Rite of Passage

292-1469-1495.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage and Court of Vantress trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1469-1495.notes: You can also control a Rite of Passage token from Court of Vantress and the combo will work the same.

2933-4013-5798-6633.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

856-1808-2511-4321.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Eloise's first ability triggers, creating a Clue and Food token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Eloise's second ability triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1558-4076-4772.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three members in your party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1558-4076-4772.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker.
Burakos triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens and causing the defending player to lose 4 life.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

413-618-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control at least one nonlegendary creature.
413-618-2178.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of any nonlegendary creature you control with haste.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Kiki-Jiki triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

500-1308-2047-2557.notablePrerequisites: You control a nonlegendary artifact creature that does not have Mechanized Production attached.
500-1308-2047-2557.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying a nonlegendary artifact creature you control and creating eight token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to, and causing you to win the game.

280-2167-3234-4050-4548.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three mana-producing lands, plus three in any combination of additional mana-producing lands and/or legendary creatures.
280-2167-3234-4050-4548.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Golgari Rot Farm, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 for each remaining mana-producing land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing World Shaper, adding {G}.
When World Shaper dies, its second ability triggers, causing you to return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Takenuma from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Takenuma's channel ability by paying at most {3}{B}, causing you to mill three cards and return World Shaper from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast World Shaper by paying {3}{G}.
Repeat.
If you control additional mana-producing lands beyond what is required, this combo nets infinite colored mana if one of those lands produces {B} or {G}, or infinite mana lands you control can produce otherwise.

1322-1563-3000-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

193-2781.notablePrerequisites: Aminatou has at least two loyalty counters.
193-2781.description:
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, blinking Aminatou.
Repeat.
